items.title: Deliver an evidence-backed bilingual kidney Help & Support directory
items.goal: Publish accessible verified EN/ES help pages with discoverable links from existing Kidney Hub
items.acceptance: All implementation children s1-s5 have merge receipts, source-checked public destinations, passing EN/ES internal/link/metadata tests, and explicit owner permission for public content publication; publish status recorded accurately.
items.next_step: Use existing website Issue #17 as scope and source record; execute child tasks in dependency order, without parallel copy of this work list.
notes: 2026-11-23: Website Issue #17 https://github.com/titoneedsakidney/titoneedsakidney.github.io/issues/17; research seed Issue #18, 17 placements/8 organizations checked 2026-09-02; these facts need recheck.

2026-11-23: Existing Book Factory cross-reference: Research platform/work-items.json resource-page-live. Website owns implementation; Book Factory owns outreach-to-public-resource promise. Portfolio queue is automationpc-platform tools/backlog.py next --portfolio.

Public publication is separately owner gated. The book is a memoir and is not medical advice. Never claim a listed organization endorses the book, nor publish correspondence or contact-level analytics.
Not part of Issue #17: already published advocacy and IgAN foundation pages (see Issues #38/#39 and merged PRs); do not recreate them.
Website navigation redesign Issue #19 is not required to make this directory discoverable; choose smallest existing-Hub path.

items.title: Verify and normalize EN/ES kidney help placements
items.goal: Record dated official website links and language/need/location for verified directory placements, excluding unsupported candidates
items.acceptance: Public data file separates organization identities from need-specific placements; includes direct official source URLs, destination language, geography, checked date, verification result and inclusion disposition for all September seed paths plus November additions; no private correspondence.
items.next_step: Read and recheck Issue #18 source data; reconcile Nov 23 Issue #17 comment #7100365565, then write only substantiated public placements.
notes: Sources: https://github.com/titoneedsakidney/titoneedsakidney.github.io/issues/18 and https://github.com/titoneedsakidney/titoneedsakidney.github.io/issues/17#issuecomment-7100365565. The September 17 placements were checked 2026-09-02 and cannot be labeled fresh without new verification.

Specific November additions: KidneyTexas homepage https://www.kidneytexas.org/; PKD-Free Alliance homepage https://www.pkdfree.org/; NKF Serving Texas office link https://www.kidney.org/offices/nkf-serving-texas is independent candidate; do not imply book endorsement, partnership, or website listing already live.
2026-11-23 excluded irrelevant DeafBlind outreach candidate remains in private CRM; no public listing, no direct email copied to GitHub.

Store unknown or stale as excluded with reason and provenance, never as verified. Same organization may have multiple resource placements; ES link only when destination actually supports ES. Prefer direct useful program routes to homepage where evidence supports them.
items.headless_why: Official source and privately confirmed preferred destination checks require an interactive investigator; do not invent support or publication evidence.

items.title: Build a deterministic resource inventory validator
items.goal: Reject unverified resource placements, missing provenance and EN/ES language mislabeling before static generation
items.acceptance: A stdlib-only validator with fixture tests refuses duplicate placement IDs, missing checked date/source/official URL, invalid language/geography, private data fields, and false partnership claims; valid 1-org-many-placements records pass.
items.next_step: Implement a pure validator and synthetic tests first, no network calls or claim that any source was rechecked.
notes: Schema fields: organization_id/name/official_url; placement_id/organization_id/need/destination_url/destination_language/geography/verified_at/source_url/status. Separate partner/endorsement from linking permission; no private personal data. Keep code small (<150 lines where reasonable).
Check conflict with existing data or validators on current main before adding this new helper. Do not invent contact or resource facts.

items.title: Generate accessible English and Spanish help pages from one dataset
items.goal: Render useful categorized kidney assistance paths in static EN/ES pages without JavaScript dependence
items.acceptance: Generator emits two semantic accessible standalone pages with correct lang, headings, focused links, plain descriptions, explicit destination languages, no unsupported medical/partner claims; synthetic HTML tests pass.
items.next_step: Follow site existing static metadata/include conventions, with a plain HTML fallback and categories by patient need; do not implement the future search-bar redesign.
notes: Ensure generator deterministic, output excludes nonverified placements, no required JS, contrast and keyboard focus, EN/ES label clarity, no language flag emoji.
Follow Issue #17 and static-site README; use provisional hub/help/ path only if consistent with current URL scheme; adjust paths on this work item with evidence before changing them.

items.title: Connect help pages from both homepages and Kidney Hubs
items.goal: Make EN/ES directory reachable via existing public site navigation without a new navigation redesign
items.acceptance: Both homepage and both Hub entry pages have a clear, same-language link to new directory; sitemap/metadata link integrity checks pass and no old advocacy/event pages are duplicated.
items.next_step: Update only existing EN/ES homepage + Kidney Hub entry links; use contextual label Help & Support / Ayuda y apoyo. Do not reopen Issue #19 global nav redesign.
notes: Before editing, inspect generated includes and current homepage link patterns; regeneration is part of existing release lane, not an unauthorized extra scope.

items.title: Validate the bilingual resource release and supply evidence
items.goal: Check source freshness, page accessibility and full static-site integrity; publish only after separate owner approval
items.acceptance: Review records exact merged commit, passing unit/integrity/metadata/sitemap/analytics tests and content permission; after approved publication, verifies two live public URLs and link path; report withheld deployment accurately.
items.next_step: Read current protected release and public-content boundaries; verify comprehensive CONTRIBUTING checks, independent link sources and dual-language parity.
notes: Public site publication is an owner-gated external action: do not deploy or approve on Tito's behalf based on task-creation authorization.
Evidence should distinguish checks passed, PR merged, deployment attempted, deployed, and live accepted. A checked resource placement is not an organizational endorsement.
